cases.literalScientificFinding: Named aqueous NaCl at 1.0 g/L is assigned approximately 199 uS/cm at 25 C (or 180/230/228 uS/cm at 20/35 C). The concentration/conductivity pairing is about a factor of ten too low. A primary NaCl standard at 1000 mg/L and 25 C has nominal conductivity 1990 uS/cm. Synthetic teaching data do not justify silently changing the physical scale of a named chemical system.
cases.minimumCorrection: Either change the NaCl concentration scale to a physically plausible approximately 0.1 g/L system or correct the conductivities. Reconcile all repeated data, units, differences and scatter. Do not blindly multiply a water blank or uncertainty by ten. Preserve the correct trend/confounding/dialogue conclusions.

cases.label: known conductivity standard unspecified
cases.literalScientificFinding: The procedure requires a known standard, but the material does not identify/provide its nominal conductivity, reference temperature or labelled uncertainty. Declare a supplied labelled standard and a meter range suitable for the prepared salt solution; distinguish quantitative conductivity from a qualitative indicator.
cases.minimumCorrection: Make the actual supplied apparatus/labels/control arrangement explicit in both languages and moderator preparation; keep actual execution unperformed.

cases.label: temperature control and quantitative range unspecified
cases.literalScientificFinding: Equal temperature is an essential controlled variable in the hypothesis, own plan and transfer. No thermometer, explicit meter temperature sensor or teacher-verified fixed-temperature arrangement is supplied. State that provision and the quantitative meter range/resolution suitable for the chosen concentrations; do not assume a qualitative indicator supplies quantitative readings.
cases.minimumCorrection: Make the actual supplied apparatus/labels/control arrangement explicit in both languages and moderator preparation; keep actual execution unperformed.

cases.label: specified 20-C condition has no declared verification/control arrangement
cases.literalScientificFinding: The water is stated to be at 20 C, but the independently performed repeated saturation plan must hold equal temperature while waiting/stirring. State how that condition is supplied and verified (e.g. teacher-verified fixed-temperature arrangement or supplied thermometer), plus usable balance resolution. This does not assert the stated initial water temperature is false.
cases.minimumCorrection: Make the actual supplied apparatus/labels/control arrangement explicit in both languages and moderator preparation; keep actual execution unperformed.

cases.label: indicator information and usable titration/calibration setup missing
cases.literalScientificFinding: An authorised unnamed indicator gives no identity, colour transition or transition range from which to justify its suitability for weak-acid titration. Supply those data/label and an authorised usable menu if choice is required. Declare receiving/titration vessels, secure burette holder and pH calibration/buffer information for the pH route. These are equipment/information gaps, not a demand to add own hypothesis formulation.
cases.minimumCorrection: Make the actual supplied apparatus/labels/control arrangement explicit in both languages and moderator preparation; keep actual execution unperformed.

cases.label: pipette filler is not a pipette; defined dilution provision missing
cases.literalScientificFinding: The kit lists pipette fillers but no actual pipettes or other quantified transfer/dilution apparatus. Supply cuvette/sample handling and volumetric pipettes/flasks or a declared equivalent with volumes/tolerances so a known twofold dilution can actually be made. Retain actual measured standards; synthetic slope does not calibrate the real dye kit.
cases.minimumCorrection: Make the actual supplied apparatus/labels/control arrangement explicit in both languages and moderator preparation; keep actual execution unperformed.

primarySupport.reason: Actual simple quantitative as well as qualitative experiments and their records are required. Method/control/dilution reasoning has to be executable using stated apparatus/information. Local safety authorisation stays independently pending.

cases.literalScientificFinding: R1 is a fictional historical teaching sheet, not a current learner experiment. The transfer demands a genuinely later temperature check but supplies neither a later traceable measurement nor an extant sample, thermometer and observed execution setup. A learner cannot retrospectively measure the fictional old sample temperature.
cases.minimumCorrection: Supply a separate traceable new temperature-measurement note and ask to append it, or explicitly supply a new supervised measurement setup and require its genuine new log. Preserve the old table, mark the new event separately and forbid retroactive verification claims.

primarySupport.reason: Authentic documentation distinguishes historical supplied data, actual new measurements and interpretation.
